info.title: SqlBound.Cli
info.description: SqlBound command-line tool: prepare offline query snapshots, scaffold migrations, and manage the database.

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Describe every [SqlQuery]/[SqlExecute] statement against the database and write .sqlbound/ snapshots.

options.name: --project
options.description: The project directory to scan for [SqlQuery]/[SqlExecute] methods (default: current directory).

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string, sqlserver:// URL, sqlite:// URL, postgresql:// URL, or mysql:// URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).

options.name: --check
options.description: Verify the committed snapshots instead of writing: exit 2 if any are stale. [default: False]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Scaffold a new timestamped migration: an up script and, unless --irreversible, a down script.

options.name: --irreversible
options.description: Scaffold only the up script; the migration cannot be reverted. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: A short description of the migration, e.g. "create items".

commands.name: run
commands.description: Apply all pending migrations, each in its own transaction.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string or provider URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).

commands.name: revert
commands.description: Revert the most recently applied migration.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string or provider URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show each migration's state: applied, pending, drifted, or missing.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string or provider URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).

commands.name: database
commands.description: Create or drop the target database.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create the target database if it does not already exist.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string or provider URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).

commands.name: drop
commands.description: Drop the target database if it exists.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string or provider URL (default: the SQLBOUND_DATABASE_URL environment variable).
